examples.english: The region has abundant rainfall throughout the year.
examples.persian: این منطقه در طول سال باران فراوانی دارد.

examples.english: She has abundant experience in international law.
examples.persian: او تجربه‌ی فراوانی در حقوق بین‌الملل دارد.

examples.english: Fresh water is not abundant in this part of the country.
examples.persian: آب شیرین در این بخش از کشور فراوان نیست.

miniContext: Before the drought began, the valley was known for abundant harvests that fed several neighboring towns. Farmers relied on the river's steady flow to keep their fields green well into autumn. When the rains finally failed, that same abundance turned scarce within a single season, and families had to ration what little remained.

examples.english: The weather forecast was accurate for the entire week.
examples.persian: پیش‌بینی آب‌وهوا برای تمام هفته دقیق بود.

examples.english: Scientists need accurate data to draw reliable conclusions.
examples.persian: دانشمندان برای رسیدن به نتیجه‌گیری‌های قابل اعتماد به داده‌های دقیق نیاز دارند.

examples.english: His account of the accident proved entirely accurate.
examples.persian: روایت او از تصادف کاملاً دقیق از آب درآمد.

miniContext: A good map is only as useful as it is accurate. Cartographers spend months cross-checking satellite images against ground surveys before publishing a new edition, because a single inaccurate border can mislead hikers or even provoke a diplomatic dispute. Readers trust a map precisely because its details have been verified, line by line.

examples.english: The hospital did not have adequate supplies during the outbreak.
examples.persian: بیمارستان در طول شیوع بیماری ملزومات کافی نداشت.

examples.english: She felt her monthly salary was barely adequate to cover rent.
examples.persian: او احساس می‌کرد حقوق ماهانه‌اش به‌سختی برای پرداخت اجاره کافی است.

examples.english: Investigators concluded that the bridge's foundations were not adequate.
examples.persian: بازرسان نتیجه گرفتند که پایه‌های پل کافی و استاندارد نبودند.

miniContext: Relief workers arriving after the earthquake found that the shelters built in the first week were barely adequate for the number of displaced families. Blankets and clean water ran short almost immediately. Within a month, however, new supply lines made conditions genuinely adequate, and the camp stabilized.

examples.english: Her admirable patience with the students impressed every parent at the meeting.
examples.persian: صبر قابل تحسین او با دانش‌آموزان همه‌ی والدین حاضر در جلسه را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.

examples.english: It was admirable of him to admit his mistake in front of the whole board.
examples.persian: کار قابل تحسینی بود که او اشتباهش را در برابر کل هیئت‌مدیره پذیرفت.

examples.english: The villagers showed admirable courage when they rebuilt the school after the flood.
examples.persian: روستاییان هنگام بازسازی مدرسه پس از سیل، شجاعتی قابل تحسین از خود نشان دادند.

miniContext: Historians often describe the nurse's wartime service as admirable, not because she sought recognition, but because she kept treating the wounded under bombardment long after safer options were available. Her diaries reveal no trace of heroism in her own eyes, only duty. It is precisely that quiet persistence that makes her story so admirable today.

examples.english: It became apparent within minutes that the peace talks had collapsed.
examples.persian: در عرض چند دقیقه آشکار شد که مذاکرات صلح به شکست خورده‌اند.

examples.english: Her disappointment was apparent to everyone in the room, though she said nothing.
examples.persian: ناامیدی او برای همه‌ی افراد حاضر در اتاق آشکار بود، هرچند چیزی نگفت.

examples.english: For no apparent reason, the negotiations collapsed overnight.
examples.persian: بدون هیچ دلیل آشکاری، مذاکرات طی یک شب به هم خورد.

miniContext: As the ship listed further to one side, the danger became apparent even to passengers who had dismissed the earlier warnings. Crew members who had seemed calm at dinner now moved with apparent urgency toward the lifeboats. What had been a minor rumor an hour before was, by midnight, an apparent emergency no one could ignore.

examples.english: It would not be appropriate to discuss salaries in front of the clients.
examples.persian: صحبت کردن درباره‌ی حقوق‌ها در حضور مشتریان مناسب نیست.

examples.english: The curators chose an appropriate venue for an exhibition of war photography.
examples.persian: متولیان موزه مکان مناسبی را برای نمایشگاه عکس‌های جنگی انتخاب کردند.

examples.english: She wore clothing appropriate for a funeral rather than her usual bright colors.
examples.persian: او به‌جای رنگ‌های روشن همیشگی‌اش، لباسی مناسب برای مراسم تشییع پوشید.

miniContext: Diplomats are trained for years to judge what is appropriate in settings where a single wrong gesture can offend a host nation. A gift that seems generous in one culture may be an appropriate insult in another. Knowing the appropriate word, tone, and distance to keep from a stranger is, in this line of work, as important as the treaty itself.

examples.english: She learned to be assertive during salary negotiations after years of staying silent.
examples.persian: او پس از سال‌ها سکوت، یاد گرفت در مذاکرات حقوق قاطع و بااعتمادبه‌نفس باشد.

examples.english: An assertive tone helped him win over the skeptical board members.
examples.persian: لحنی قاطع و بااعتمادبه‌نفس به او کمک کرد نظر اعضای مردد هیئت‌مدیره را جلب کند.

examples.english: Being assertive does not mean being rude to the people around you.
examples.persian: قاطع و بااعتمادبه‌نفس بودن به معنای بی‌ادب بودن با اطرافیان نیست.

miniContext: Therapists often distinguish assertive communication from aggression: the assertive person states a need clearly without attacking the listener. A manager who is assertive, for instance, can refuse an unreasonable deadline while still respecting the client on the other end of the call. Many people confuse the two styles, but learning to be assertive, rather than either passive or hostile, tends to improve both relationships and results.

examples.english: The attentive waiter noticed the empty glass before anyone had to ask.
examples.persian: پیشخدمت با دقت و توجه، قبل از اینکه کسی بخواهد، متوجه لیوان خالی شد.

examples.english: Attentive readers will catch the hidden clue buried in the third chapter.
examples.persian: خوانندگانی که با دقت و توجه می‌خوانند، سرنخ پنهان در فصل سوم را خواهند یافت.

examples.english: She remained attentive throughout the three-hour lecture, taking notes the entire time.
examples.persian: او در طول سخنرانی سه‌ساعته با دقت و توجه کامل گوش داد و تمام مدت یادداشت‌برداری کرد.

miniContext: A good nurse must be attentive to details that a patient may not even mention — a change in breathing, a flicker of hesitation before answering a question. On the ward, this quiet, attentive watchfulness often catches complications long before any machine does. Patients rarely praise it by name, but they notice when a caregiver is truly attentive.

examples.english: The museum spent months verifying that the painting was authentic.
examples.persian: موزه ماه‌ها وقت صرف کرد تا تأیید کند که نقاشی اصیل و واقعی است.

examples.english: He wandered the old quarter searching for an authentic bowl of pho.
examples.persian: او در محله‌ی قدیمی شهر به دنبال یک کاسه فوی اصیل و واقعی می‌گشت.

examples.english: Her authentic reaction, rather than a rehearsed one, moved the entire audience.
examples.persian: واکنش اصیل و واقعی او، نه یک واکنش تمرین‌شده، تمام حضار را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.

miniContext: Forgers had copied the artist's signature so precisely that only a chemical analysis of the paint could tell the authentic canvases from the fakes. Collectors paid staggering sums for what they believed was an authentic original, only to learn decades later that an entire gallery had been built on forgeries. Today, museums treat authenticity as seriously as they treat the art itself.

examples.english: Regular exercise is beneficial for cardiovascular health even in small doses.
examples.persian: ورزش منظم حتی در دوزهای کم برای سلامت قلب و عروق سودمند است.

examples.english: The trade agreement proved beneficial to both nations within its first year.
examples.persian: توافق‌نامه‌ی تجاری در همان سال اول برای هر دو کشور سودمند از آب درآمد.

examples.english: An unexpected side effect of the quarantine was beneficial to the city's air quality.
examples.persian: یک اثر جانبی غیرمنتظره‌ی قرنطینه برای کیفیت هوای شهر سودمند بود.

miniContext: Beekeepers insist that the relationship between bees and orchard owners is mutually beneficial: the bees gain nectar, and the trees gain pollination that no human hand could replicate at scale. Researchers have since found that this beneficial exchange extends far beyond orchards, shaping the health of entire ecosystems. Without it, many of the fruits and vegetables sold today simply would not exist.

examples.english: She is fully capable of running the department on her own.
examples.persian: او کاملاً توانمند است که به‌تنهایی اداره‌ی آن بخش را عهده‌دار شود.

examples.english: A capable leader listens carefully before making any final decision.
examples.persian: یک رهبر توانمند پیش از گرفتن هر تصمیم نهایی با دقت گوش می‌دهد.

examples.english: The old engine is no longer capable of reaching its original top speed.
examples.persian: موتور قدیمی دیگر توانمند به رسیدن به سرعت اولیه‌ی خود نیست.

miniContext: After her predecessor resigned amid scandal, few believed the junior minister was capable of holding the coalition together. Within a year, she had proven capable of far more than that, negotiating a budget that satisfied rivals on both sides. Her critics eventually admitted that they had badly underestimated how capable she truly was.

examples.english: Investors remained cautious for months after the market crash.
examples.persian: سرمایه‌گذاران برای ماه‌ها پس از سقوط بازار محتاط باقی ماندند.

examples.english: He gave a cautious reply, unwilling to commit to either side of the dispute.
examples.persian: او پاسخی محتاطانه داد و حاضر نشد جانب هیچ‌کدام از طرفین دعوا را بگیرد.

examples.english: Doctors remain cautious about prescribing the new drug to young children.
examples.persian: پزشکان درباره‌ی تجویز داروی جدید به کودکان خرد همچنان محتاط هستند.

miniContext: Climbers who survive the mountain for decades tend to share one trait: they are cautious even when conditions look perfect. A cautious guide will turn a group back from the summit at the first sign of changing weather, no matter how close the top seems. Those who ignore that caution are often the ones the rescue teams never find in time.

examples.english: The new surgeon proved highly competent during her very first operation.
examples.persian: جراح جدید در همان نخستین عمل جراحی‌اش بسیار شایسته و کارآمد از آب درآمد.

examples.english: Only a truly competent translator can capture the rhythm of the original poem.
examples.persian: تنها یک مترجم واقعاً شایسته و کارآمد می‌تواند ریتم شعر اصلی را منتقل کند.

examples.english: He was competent enough to manage the crisis without calling in outside help.
examples.persian: او به‌قدری شایسته و کارآمد بود که بدون کمک خارجی توانست بحران را مدیریت کند.

miniContext: The committee did not need a brilliant chairperson, only a competent one who could keep meetings on schedule and disputes from boiling over. For three years, the role fell to a quiet accountant whose competent handling of the budget earned the trust of members who had distrusted every predecessor. Competence, it turned out, mattered more than charisma.

examples.english: It was considerate of her to lower her voice near the sleeping baby.
examples.persian: کار ملاحظه‌کارانه‌ای بود که او نزدیک نوزاد خوابیده صدایش را پایین آورد.

examples.english: A considerate neighbor would have warned us about the renovation noise in advance.
examples.persian: یک همسایه‌ی ملاحظه‌کار از قبل ما را از سر و صدای بازسازی باخبر می‌کرد.

examples.english: He is always considerate of other people's time, arriving early to every meeting.
examples.persian: او همیشه ملاحظه‌کار وقت دیگران است و به هر جلسه زودتر می‌رسد.

miniContext: Etiquette, at its core, is simply being considerate in ways that a stranger will notice without you having to explain them. A considerate host checks dietary restrictions before the dinner party, not during it. Small as these gestures seem, a considerate habit practiced for years becomes, to everyone around a person, indistinguishable from genuine kindness.

examples.english: Her performance on the track has been remarkably consistent all season.
examples.persian: عملکرد او در پیست در طول کل فصل به‌طور قابل‌توجهی با ثبات بوده است.

examples.english: The witness's story was not consistent with the physical evidence at the scene.
examples.persian: روایت شاهد با مدارک فیزیکی موجود در صحنه سازگار نبود.

examples.english: A consistent sleep schedule tends to improve concentration during the day.
examples.persian: یک برنامه‌ی خواب با ثبات معمولاً تمرکز را در طول روز بهبود می‌بخشد.

miniContext: Coaches often value a consistent runner over a brilliant but erratic one, because a race can be planned around steady, predictable splits. The athlete who finishes within a few seconds of the same time every week gives a team something to rely on. It was this consistent pacing, more than any single dazzling performance, that eventually won her a place on the national squad.

examples.english: The editor offered constructive criticism instead of simply praising the manuscript.
examples.persian: ویراستار به‌جای تحسین صرف دست‌نوشته، نقدی سازنده ارائه داد.

examples.english: Their constructive dialogue finally ended a border dispute that had lasted a decade.
examples.persian: گفت‌وگوی سازنده‌ی آن‌ها سرانجام به اختلاف مرزی‌ای که یک دهه طول کشیده بود پایان داد.

examples.english: He channeled his frustration into something constructive by organizing the neighborhood cleanup.
examples.persian: او ناکامی‌اش را به کاری سازنده تبدیل کرد و پاکسازی محله را سازمان داد.

miniContext: A good workshop depends on feedback that is constructive rather than merely critical — pointing not only at what fails but at how it might be fixed. Writers who receive constructive notes tend to revise with more confidence than those who are simply told a draft is weak. The most useful mentors are remembered less for their praise than for how constructive their harshest comments turned out to be.

examples.english: Her convincing argument swayed even the most skeptical members of the jury.
examples.persian: استدلال قانع‌کننده‌ی او حتی شکاک‌ترین اعضای هیئت‌منصفه را هم متقاعد کرد.

examples.english: The alibi sounded convincing until the detective noticed a flaw in the timeline.
examples.persian: بی‌گناهی‌اش قانع‌کننده به نظر می‌رسید تا اینکه کارآگاه نقصی در زمان‌بندی داستان یافت.

examples.english: He gave a convincing performance as the grieving widower in the final act.
examples.persian: او در پرده‌ی پایانی اجرایی قانع‌کننده از نقش بیوه‌مرد داغدار ارائه داد.

miniContext: Trial lawyers spend as much time rehearsing tone and pacing as they do researching facts, because even true testimony can fail to be convincing if delivered poorly. A convincing closing argument often rests less on new evidence than on how clearly the existing evidence is woven together. Juries, in the end, tend to believe not the loudest voice but the most convincing one.

examples.english: The staff remained courteous even when dealing with the rudest customers.
examples.persian: کارکنان حتی هنگام برخورد با بدرفتارترین مشتریان همچنان مودب ماندند.

examples.english: A courteous driver yields to pedestrians waiting at the crossing.
examples.persian: یک راننده‌ی مودب به عابرانی که در گذرگاه منتظرند حق تقدم می‌دهد.

examples.english: She sent a courteous reply despite her obvious frustration with the delay.
examples.persian: او با وجود ناراحتی واضحش از تأخیر، پاسخی مودبانه فرستاد.

miniContext: Flight attendants are trained to stay courteous through turbulence, delays, and the occasional difficult passenger, because a courteous tone can defuse a tense cabin faster than any announcement. The job rarely rewards this skill publicly, yet a courteous crew is often the single biggest factor in whether a bad flight is remembered as merely unpleasant or truly unbearable.

examples.english: The journalist refused to publish the story without a credible source.
examples.persian: روزنامه‌نگار بدون یک منبع قابل اعتماد حاضر به انتشار خبر نشد.

examples.english: His explanation was not credible given the timeline the police had already established.
examples.persian: با توجه به زمان‌بندی‌ای که پلیس از قبل مشخص کرده بود، توضیح او قابل اعتماد نبود.

examples.english: Only witnesses the court considered credible were allowed to testify at trial.
examples.persian: تنها شاهدانی که دادگاه آن‌ها را قابل اعتماد می‌دانست اجازه‌ی شهادت یافتند.

miniContext: A rumor spreads regardless of truth, but a credible claim requires something sturdier: a named source, a verifiable document, a pattern that holds up under scrutiny. Editors are taught to ask whether a tip is credible before it is newsworthy, because a single uncorroborated story can destroy a newsroom's reputation overnight. Readers, too, have grown warier, trusting outlets that have earned a reputation for being credible over those that merely shout the loudest.

examples.english: The general's decisive action ended the siege within a single day.
examples.persian: اقدام قاطع ژنرال در عرض یک روز به محاصره پایان داد.

examples.english: She remained decisive in a crisis, never hesitating over small details.
examples.persian: او در بحران همواره قاطع می‌ماند و هرگز روی جزئیات کوچک تردید نمی‌کرد.

examples.english: The third goal proved decisive in a match that had otherwise seemed even.
examples.persian: گل سوم در بازی‌ای که در غیر این صورت برابر به نظر می‌رسید، قاطع و تعیین‌کننده بود.

miniContext: Historians still debate why the young commander, untested in battle, acted so decisively at the river crossing while his more experienced rivals hesitated. That single decisive order, launched before dawn, caught the opposing army completely unprepared. It is the kind of decisive moment that textbooks reduce to a sentence but that changed the course of the entire campaign.

examples.english: Investigators ruled the warehouse fire deliberate rather than accidental.
examples.persian: بازرسان آتش‌سوزی انبار را عمدی و سنجیده‌شده، نه تصادفی، تشخیص دادند.

examples.english: She spoke in a slow, deliberate voice to calm the panicking crowd.
examples.persian: او با صدایی آرام و سنجیده صحبت کرد تا جمعیت دستخوش وحشت را آرام کند.

examples.english: His deliberate silence during the interview unsettled the reporters in the room.
examples.persian: سکوت عمدی و سنجیده‌ی او در طول مصاحبه خبرنگاران حاضر را به‌هم ریخت.

miniContext: The architect's every choice in the chapel felt deliberate, down to the narrow window that let in a single shaft of light at noon. Nothing in the design was accidental; each deliberate decision pointed the visitor's eye toward the altar. Centuries later, scholars still argue about just how deliberate certain details were meant to be.

examples.english: Her old pickup truck has proven dependable for more than twenty years.
examples.persian: کامیونچه‌ی قدیمی او برای بیش از بیست سال قابل اتکا بوده است.

examples.english: He built a reputation as a dependable partner during the most difficult negotiations.
examples.persian: او طی سخت‌ترین مذاکرات به‌عنوان شریکی قابل اتکا شناخته شد.

examples.english: The village has relied on a single, dependable well for generations.
examples.persian: روستا برای نسل‌ها به یک چاه واحد و قابل اتکا تکیه کرده است.

miniContext: Long before satellites existed, sailors trusted the North Star as the one dependable point in a shifting sky. A dependable landmark like that could mean the difference between reaching port and drifting for weeks. Even today, pilots are taught to keep at least one dependable backup instrument for exactly the moments when everything else fails.

examples.english: Waterfront property has remained desirable despite years of rising prices.
examples.persian: املاک ساحلی با وجود سال‌ها افزایش قیمت، همچنان مطلوب باقی مانده است.

examples.english: It is desirable for candidates to have at least two years of fieldwork experience.
examples.persian: داشتن حداقل دو سال تجربه‌ی میدانی برای داوطلبان مطلوب است.

examples.english: The company's stock became far less desirable after the scandal broke.
examples.persian: پس از افشای رسوایی، سهام شرکت بسیار کمتر مطلوب شد.

miniContext: Urban planners spend careers trying to understand what makes a neighborhood desirable: good schools, walkable streets, a sense of safety after dark. Once a district becomes desirable, rents tend to rise faster than wages, pushing out the very residents who made it appealing in the first place. Balancing that tension remains one of the hardest problems in city planning.

examples.english: The diligent archivist catalogued every letter in the collection by hand.
examples.persian: بایگان کوشا تمام نامه‌های موجود در مجموعه را با دست فهرست‌بندی کرد.

examples.english: Her diligent preparation paid off during the three-hour oral examination.
examples.persian: تلاش کوشای او در آمادگی، در طول آزمون شفاهی سه‌ساعته نتیجه داد.

examples.english: He remained diligent about his studies even during the long summer holidays.
examples.persian: او حتی در طول تعطیلات طولانی تابستان هم در مطالعاتش کوشا باقی ماند.

miniContext: No single discovery made the scholar famous; what mattered was decades of diligent, unglamorous work cross-referencing thousands of fragile manuscripts. Colleagues often forgot how diligent the process had to be before any grand theory could be published. It was this patient, diligent labor, far more than sudden insight, that eventually rewrote the history of the period.

examples.english: The two dialects have distinct pronunciations despite sharing most of their grammar.
examples.persian: این دو گویش با وجود اشتراک در بیشتر دستور زبان، تلفظ‌های متمایزی دارند.

examples.english: There was a distinct smell of smoke drifting through the hallway.
examples.persian: بویی متمایز از دود در راهرو پراکنده بود.

examples.english: Each chapter of the book explores a distinct period of the empire's decline.
examples.persian: هر فصل از کتاب به دوره‌ای متمایز از فروپاشی امپراتوری می‌پردازد.

miniContext: Linguists studying the coastline found that each fishing village, though only a few kilometers apart, had developed a distinct accent over centuries of relative isolation. What outsiders heard as one regional dialect was, to residents, a dozen distinct voices, each tied to a particular stretch of shore. Modern roads have begun to blur those distinct boundaries, much to the dismay of local historians.

examples.english: The new vaccine proved effective against most strains of the virus.
examples.persian: واکسن جدید در برابر بیشتر گونه‌های ویروس موثر از آب درآمد.

examples.english: A short, effective speech can move a crowd more than a long one.
examples.persian: یک سخنرانی کوتاه و موثر می‌تواند جمعیت را بیش از یک سخنرانی طولانی تحت تأثیر قرار دهد.

examples.english: Their effective use of terraced irrigation turned the hillside into productive farmland.
examples.persian: استفاده‌ی موثر آن‌ها از آبیاری پشته‌ای، دامنه‌ی کوه را به زمین کشاورزی پربازده تبدیل کرد.

miniContext: Public health campaigns succeed or fail largely on whether their message is effective, not merely accurate. A warning that is technically correct but ignored by the public is, in practical terms, useless. The most effective campaigns in history often relied on a single memorable image or phrase rather than pages of statistics.

examples.english: Solar panels have become far more efficient over the past decade.
examples.persian: پنل‌های خورشیدی در طول دهه‌ی گذشته بسیار کارآمدتر شده‌اند.

examples.english: An efficient bureaucracy processed the refugees' documents within a single week.
examples.persian: یک نظام اداری کارآمد اسناد پناهجویان را در عرض تنها یک هفته پردازش کرد.

examples.english: She found a more efficient route through the mountains that saved two days.
examples.persian: او مسیری کارآمدتر از میان کوه‌ها پیدا کرد که دو روز زمان را صرفه‌جویی کرد.

miniContext: Engineers measure an engine not only by its power but by how efficient it is at converting fuel into motion rather than wasted heat. A slightly less powerful but more efficient design often wins out over decades of use, because efficiency compounds in ways raw power never does. The history of the combustion engine is, in large part, a history of the relentless pursuit of being more efficient.

examples.english: Only citizens over the age of eighteen are eligible to vote.
examples.persian: تنها شهروندان بالای هجده سال واجد شرایط رای دادن هستند.

examples.english: Veterans of the conflict are eligible for additional healthcare benefits.
examples.persian: کهنه‌سربازان آن جنگ واجد شرایط دریافت مزایای درمانی اضافی هستند.

examples.english: She became eligible for parole after serving ten years of her sentence.
examples.persian: او پس از گذراندن ده سال از دوران محکومیتش واجد شرایط آزادی مشروط شد.

miniContext: Scholarship committees often receive thousands of applications from students who are academically outstanding but simply not eligible under the program's narrow residency rules. Being eligible, in other words, is sometimes a matter of paperwork rather than merit. Advocates have spent years lobbying to make the eligible pool wider, arguing that talent should matter more than a birth certificate.

examples.english: The enthusiastic crowd kept cheering long after the final whistle blew.
examples.persian: جمعیت مشتاق مدت‌ها پس از سوت پایان همچنان به تشویق ادامه داد.

examples.english: He remained enthusiastic about the project despite two years of setbacks.
examples.persian: او با وجود دو سال شکست، همچنان نسبت به پروژه مشتاق باقی ماند.

examples.english: Her enthusiastic review convinced thousands of readers to buy the obscure novel.
examples.persian: نقد مشتاقانه‌ی او هزاران خواننده را به خرید آن رمان کمتر شناخته‌شده ترغیب کرد.

miniContext: Few people expected the small-town librarian's enthusiastic recommendations to matter beyond her own town, yet her weekly newsletter grew an enthusiastic following that eventually reached publishers themselves. Authors began crediting her enthusiastic early reviews with saving books that had otherwise gone unnoticed. It turned out that genuine, unpaid enthusiasm could move markets that advertising budgets could not.

examples.english: Clean water is essential for preventing disease in refugee camps.
examples.persian: آب پاک برای پیشگیری از بیماری در اردوگاه‌های پناهجویان ضروری است.

examples.english: It is essential to back up your files before installing the update.
examples.persian: پیش از نصب به‌روزرسانی، پشتیبان‌گیری از فایل‌ها ضروری است.

examples.english: Patience proved essential during the long and often fruitless negotiations.
examples.persian: صبر در طول مذاکرات طولانی و اغلب بی‌نتیجه ضروری از آب درآمد.

miniContext: During the siege, salt became as essential as bread, since without it the little meat that remained could not be preserved through winter. Historians note how often the essential goods of a crisis turn out to be the most ordinary ones, overlooked until they vanish. What people consider essential, in other words, says as much about the crisis as it does about the good itself.
